implementation: Surface typed message_id/nudge and reject resolved Supabase RPC errors.
Keep request/provider thread identity, message timestamps and focused refresh.
Preserve the draft and withhold success until the returned message is read back in the exact thread.
Retain readable messages while showing a read-only explanation when the request state does not allow messaging.
Keep the server-returned leakage nudge visible.
testCasesAuthored: Resolved RPC error retains the draft and does not show success.
Booked, cancelled and expired threads are read-only while existing messages remain visible.
Returned message ID is verified against timestamped readback.
Customer and authorized business staff can send; an unrelated identity cannot read or send.
Booked, cancelled and expired requests remain denied by the unchanged server RPC.
Messages and drafts are isolated when the authenticated user changes, including while a pre-send read is pending.

correctedAttempts.cause: The success fixture body differed from the submitted draft; the fixture was corrected.
The success assertion expected the old fixture body; it now checks the returned fixture body.
The request recipient fixture omitted required provider_service_id; the fixture now creates and supplies an exact provider service.

findings.finding: Thread state/send context originally omitted userId, allowing state to remain visible across account changes.
findings.resolution: Included userId in the composite context key, failed closed on context changes until scoped state reload, and added an account-switch test.

findings.finding: An account change during the pre-send message-list read could still dispatch the RPC under the replacement session.
findings.resolution: Rechecked the composite context key after the pre-send read and before RPC dispatch; added a focused race test.
